details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has warned that a prolonged war in the Middle East and further disruptions to energy production, shipping routes, or critical infrastructure pose the biggest risk to the region's economies. The IMF noted that pre-war buffers are finite, and renewed disruptions could lead to much larger price adjustments.
title: IMF Warns Prolonged M.East War Risks Regional Economies

details: Hotter-than-expected US Consumer Price Index (CPI) data, showing a 3.7% year-over-year increase, has intensified concerns of persistent inflation. This development increased expectations for further Federal Reserve interest rate hikes, triggering a broad risk-off movement in financial markets. Consequently, Bitcoin experienced a drop of over 1%, and various altcoins also saw declines. US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) recorded $261.5 million in outflows.
title: Hot US Inflation Spurs Rate Hike Bets, Bitcoin Slides

details: A substantial $12.03 million Bitcoin perpetual futures long position was forcibly liquidated on Binance on October 14 at 10:28 p.m. ET. This event underscores the inherent risks associated with leveraged trading in the cryptocurrency market and contributed to a general market downturn, with 44 out of 50 major cryptocurrencies experiencing declines.
title: $12M Bitcoin Futures Long Liquidated on Binance
